_notes.reference_prompt_lock: MUST be set. The module default REFERENCE_PROMPT_LOCK says 'Render in a semi-realistic modern animated-feature illustration style' — inheriting it makes every dog a cartoon. Refs control IDENTITY; the lock/tail text controls FIDELITY. Banked 09 Jul after shot_003 came back Pixar-glossy with a perfect liver nose.
_notes.negations: 'not an illustration / not a cartoon' is safe here: NB2 is reasoning-guided, and qqrew's working lock uses 'never bored, never pouty'. The Flux-negation trap (naming a thing summons it) applies to the diffusion text path, not this endpoint.
_notes.render_mode: reference = beats whose image_prompt carries a {token} in reference_map render via fal /edit conditioned on those refs. Token-free beats fall through to text-to-image AND have the people-directive stripped (Rule 1: person-free by definition).
_notes.canon: Every {token} used in any VISUAL must have a canon entry — _expand_canon raises SystemExit on unknown tags. Tokens do double duty: attach the reference images AND expand into the prompt text.
_notes.timing_source: beatsheet = no narration-timed audio leg. Timing declared per beat; VO is a sparse removable layer.
_notes.default_beat_hold: 3.0s is a FLOOR, not a target. With narration on every beat, duration resolves to max(3.0, clip + 0.4) — so pacing follows the voice, exactly as a narration-timed channel would, but authored rather than Whisper-measured. Was 6.0 during the wordless experiment, which left the film 71% silence (52s of speech in 180s) and made it unwatchable. Banked 09 Jul: silence is not the same as restraint.
_notes.size_word: No size adjective in the canon on purpose — 'miniature' was a canon error. The reference images carry the correct medium build.
_notes.reference_map: ONE ref per token — a plain string, not a list. Proven 09 Jul: the same prompt, lock, tail and endpoint rendered a glossy illustration with TWO refs (face+body) and a clean photograph with ONE. Handing NB2 /edit multiple portrait refs pushes it to synthesise rather than photograph, and it falls back to its illustration prior. qqrew has always used single-string refs and has always been photoreal. The code accepts a list (recreation_pipeline ~1540) but the model does not reward it. Body proportions are carried by the canon text and, for two-handers, by pair_body.png.
_notes.both_dogs: Conditions on pair_body.png alone. That single frame must carry BOTH identities at scene distance. Unproven — watch shots 6, 8, 24, 28, 30 at the stills gate for face softening or coat bleed.
_notes.wordless_experiment: The wordless-spine hypothesis (Koko/Kiki transcribe to nothing) FAILED on this channel. Those are ambient/eating loops with attached audiences. A CAPER has plot — a plan, a lookout, a betrayal, a punchline — and plot lives in Bentley's head. Silence killed it. The timing_source=beatsheet path stays: declared holds beat Whisper-measured ones for physical comedy, because the pause is the joke. What changed is that every beat now speaks. Bentley narrates as BOTH the in-shot character and the abstract narrator, including shots he is not in.
_notes.bentley_voice: Recast 10 Jul: 3XOBzXhnDY98yeWQ3GdM @1.0 -> PzuBz8h2SxBvQ7lnUC44 @1.15. The first voice was chosen for short smug interjections; the format is now continuous narration across ~39 beats, and a voice that lands in bursts can grate at length. 1.15 keeps the schemer's forward drive over a long read.
_notes.watson_voice: Watson is SILENT in the World Cup format — Bentley reports him ('I know exactly what that face means'). The voice entry stays in the map: it is inert (no [watson] tag in the script) and costs nothing, and an episode may one day earn him a single line again.
_notes.canon_stadium: stadium and team are CANON-ONLY tokens: they expand into the prompt but have no reference_map entry, so no image is attached (the resolver's regex only fires on tokens present in reference_map; _expand_canon covers all canon keys, and patch_modea_beats_canon only requires reference_map ⊆ canon). One string, repeated verbatim, holds a world far better than forty individually-described stadiums.
_notes.mixed_team_shield: A pitch of MIXED dachshunds is a canon-drift shield: only Bentley and Watson are ref-locked, so variation in the surrounding dogs is by design rather than artifact. Banked 10 Jul.
_notes.frozen_peak_action: Ken-Burns beats must be captured at the instant of MAXIMUM energy — paw on ball, dog inverted mid-kick, jaw open in disbelief. A frozen peak-action frame cannot hallucinate; Kling can. Motion is implied by the frame, not generated. Kling is reserved for the cold open and the final goal.
